7-b.decision_correctness_justification: The reference applies likelihood masking, per-run smoothing at the frame rate, differentiation against real frame times, per-bin averaging, per-view normalization, and two-view combination. The AI instead interpolated raw positions to the neural grid first, differentiated there, zero-filled NaNs, and skipped the two-view normalization/combination logic.
